#! Smart-documentation fixture: pins how `#!` lexes against plain `#`.
#! A doc ref looks like ![brave] or, kind-qualified, ![effect:my_fx].

# An ordinary comment. Everything on this line is prose, including a ![ref]
# that must NOT be treated as documentation.

##! Two hashes open a plain comment; the `!` is just text.

#!
#!Tight against the bang, no leading space.

scripted_effect my_fx = {
	#! Indented doc comment inside a block, referencing ![brave].
	add_gold = 1 #! trailing doc comment after real tokens
	add_prestige = 2 # trailing plain comment
}

other = {
	my_fx = yes
	value = "a # inside a string is not a comment"
	other = "a #! inside a string is not documentation"
}
